narrative.overview:
Signal Plate looks like a printed routing diagram: matte cobalt, peach terminals, and hairline rules. Flat fields and an original vector monogram carry the identity.

The warm paper index is the quieter counterpart. Oversized Chivo sets the hierarchy; system text and ruled rows make the links easy to scan. A pale blue tint and a ringed peach terminal show where a topic link landed.
keyCharacteristics: Matte cobalt and warm paper, with peach used as a signal.
Heavy Chivo paired with compact, readable system text.
Square frames, thin rules, round terminals, and inline SVG.

rules.name: The Peach Signal Rule
rules.body: Use peach for terminals, directional marks, and identity accents. In the paper index, standalone links stay cobalt; only the targeted group's pin turns peach, with a cobalt outline.

rules.name: The Chivo for Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reserve Chivo for the wordmark and headings; use system text for copy, navigation, and captions.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: No shadows. Separate surfaces with a change of ground, a keyline, or space; show interaction with a fill, underline, or outline rather than lift.

dos: Do use native links and fragment targets so navigation and content work without JavaScript.
Do keep the skip link, meaningful headings, visible text labels, and the `2px` current-color focus outline with `4px` offset.
Do keep decorative arrows and marks out of the accessibility tree.
donts: Don't add shadows or round the structural frames.
Don't ship raster artwork; keep the schematic mark and icons as vectors.
